summary: Richardson Electronics filed an 8-K (Items 2.02/9.01) furnishing its Q1 FY2027 earnings release and declaring a $0.06 quarterly cash dividend. Net sales rose 18.9% year over year, with growth across all three business units; net income doubled to $4.1 million, or $0.27 per diluted share. The company generated $4.2 million of free cash flow, and backlog stood at $184.4 million, up 36.9% year over year. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special-situation event; no deal or structural terms were disclosed.
